checks.name: auth-and-authz
checks.output_summary: No routes, endpoints, or auth mechanisms introduced. Demo tool has no user sessions.

checks.name: input-validation
checks.output_summary: All data flows through GuardrailTestWireSchema.parse() before any field access. One low finding: no length constraints on z.string() fields — not exploitable in current fixture-driven scope.

checks.name: output-handling-xss
checks.output_summary: All fields rendered via JSX text interpolation. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML anywhere in changed files. code field rendered as <pre> text node.

checks.name: injection
checks.output_summary: No SQL, shell, template, or LDAP injection paths. No database or subprocess usage.

checks.name: ssrf
checks.output_summary: No outbound HTTP requests introduced. All imports are static JSON at compile time.

checks.name: path-traversal
checks.output_summary: No filesystem paths constructed from runtime data. All JSON imports are static compile-time paths.

checks.name: secret-exposure
checks.output_summary: No hard-coded secrets, API keys, tokens. No process.env access. No NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables. Fixture contains only domain data.

checks.name: dependencies
checks.output_summary: No new dependencies added. package.json unchanged.

checks.name: configuration
checks.output_summary: strict:true in tsconfig.json. No dangerouslyAllowSVG. No wildcard CORS. CSP absence is pre-existing gap (INFO-001).

findings.message: z.string() fields in GuardrailTestSchema have no length constraints. The 'code' field is unbounded. Not exploitable with current fixture-driven data source, but becomes relevant if Feature 6 introduces a live API response path.
findings.evidence: code: z.string(), rationale: z.string(), detectionNote: z.string() — all unbounded
findings.suggested_action: When Feature 6 introduces an API data path, add z.string().max(N) to 'code' (e.g. max 32000 chars) and prose fields (e.g. max 2000 chars). This is a pre-emptive recommendation for the Feature 6 plan, not a required fix for Feature 5.

findings.message: No HTTP security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy) configured. Pre-existing gap not introduced by this feature.
findings.suggested_action: Track as a follow-up hardening item. Not required for Feature 5 merge. For production readiness, add headers() to next.config.ts.

findings.message: Both wire schemas use .passthrough(), allowing unknown extra fields to survive Zod parse. The mapper discards them — they never reach the UI. Pattern is intentional and consistent with project-wide convention.
findings.suggested_action: No action required for Feature 5. When Feature 6 introduces live API responses, consider whether .strict() is more appropriate to detect API contract drift.

findings.message: navigator.clipboard.writeText() copies guardrailTest.code to system clipboard. One-directional (app to clipboard only). Error path correctly silenced. The copy-label reset setTimeout does not require cleanup as it only affects local state and has a 2s duration.
findings.suggested_action: No action required. Pattern is correct and secure.
